name: schema_context
description: The warehouse tables, columns, measured joins and hazards relevant to a question. Call this first, before writing SQL.

name: search_tables
description: Ranked tables matching a text query, each with a one-line description.

name: describe_table
description: Everything known about one table: columns, keys, joins, values, pitfalls.

name: find_join_path
description: Measured join routes between two tables with join keys and a SQL snippet, or the reason there is none. Never invent a join this tool does not return.

name: column_values
description: Observed and declared values of one column, as the value policy allows them.

name: explain_term
description: What a business term or metric means and which tables it maps to.
